title: 12 For what cauſe God differreth that iudgement.

segments.text: HEE differreth it, 1 To exerciſe faith, patience, hope, and praier in the Godlie. 2 That all the elect may bee gathered vnto the Church. For in reſpect of them, and not in reſpect of the wicked, doth the world continue. For the creatures were made for the children of the houſe: The wicked vſe them as theeues and robbers. Nowe God will haue the elect gathered by ordinary meanes: he will haue them in this life to heare the word, and by it to be renewed & conuerted; vnto which is required ſome tract of time. 3 He differeth it, that hee might grant vnto all a time and ſpace of repentaunce, as at this time: and that his differring might leaue the wicked & obſtinate without excuſe. Rom. 2.4. Deſpiſeſt thou the riches of his bountifulneſſe, and patience, and long ſufferance, not knowing that the bountifulneſſe of God leadeth thee to repentance?
